revenue.source: Amazon 10-K FY2025 (acc. 0001018724-26-000004), consolidated statements of operations, total net sales

d_and_a.source: Cash flow statement line 'Depreciation and amortization of property and equipment and capitalized content costs, operating lease assets, and other': FY2023 48,663 and FY2024 52,795 from FY2024 10-K (0001018724-25-000004); FY2025 65,756 from Q4 2025 earnings release (ir.aboutamazon.com)

capex.source: Cash flow statement 'Purchases of property and equipment' (gross, before proceeds from sales/incentives), FY2025 Annual Report / 10-K 0001018724-26-000004

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 12.4% (716,924 vs 637,959), FY2024 11.0%; AWS/ads mix supports double-digit growth, fading toward maturity as base grows.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 11.2% (79,975/716,924), FY2024 10.8%; modest expansion from AWS and advertising mix, offset by heavy AI/Leo cost and depreciation.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~19.6% (provision 19,087 / pre-tax income 97,311 per 10-K); rounded to 19%.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A was 9.2% of revenue (65,756/716,924) and rising with capex build-out; 9.5% used.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 gross capex was 18.4% of revenue (131,819/716,924), FY2024 13.0%; assume intensity eases gradually to 16% average as AI buildout normalizes. Flat across years for simplicity; reviewer should consider a declining path.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM-style estimate, beta ~1.2-1.3, risk-free ~4.2%, ERP ~5% gives cost of equity ~10%; minimal debt weight gives WACC ~9%. Not from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal GDP growth, below risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: 10-K FY2025 balance sheet/debt note: long-term debt 65,648 + current portion 2,748 = 68,396, less cash 86,810, less marketable securities 36,219; excludes lease liabilities. Negative = net cash.

diluted_shares.source: FY2025 Annual Report: weighted-average diluted shares 10,827 million
